title: 20 · elephant_hide · The Elephant's Hide
lines: An elephant the size of a hill once charged a Shiva temple.
Shiva met him from the inside.
Gajasura, the elephant demon, had a boon.
No one driven by desire could kill him.
Gods want victory. Men want glory. Everyone wants something.
The sages ran to the lingam and held on.
And Shiva rose out of the stone.
And the darkness came apart around him like a cloak.
With his last breath, Gajasura asked for one thing.
Wear me. Let me never be far from you.
"Wear me. Let me never be far from you."
And Shiva drew the hide around his shoulders.
In Kashi he is still called Krittivasa:
the one who wears the hide.
Even what came to destroy you can end at your side. That is sadhana.
